headline: Bang Overseas Limited: Brijgopal Bang Takeover Disclosure Under SEBI Regulation 31(4)
sum: Brijgopal Bang has filed a mandatory disclosure of substantial acquisition of shares in Bang Overseas Limited under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The exact quantum of shares and consideration remain undisclosed in the publicly available summary.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosure obligation triggers when an acquirer reaches or crosses 5% threshold; the filing signals material change in shareholding and activates open offer or exemption review requirements under SEBI Takeover Code.
detail: Brijgopal Bang has submitted a formal disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011 to the National Stock Exchange, indicating a substantial acquisition of shares in Bang Overseas Limited. The disclosure is a mandatory requirement triggered by crossing prescribed thresholds of shareholding. No further details regarding the quantum of shares, consideration, or timeline of acquisition are evident from the filed disclosure summary.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 – Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure requirement for substantial acquisition of shares; filing with exchange and company secretary within 2 business days of acquisition triggering event (5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, 50% thresholds).
Defines threshold events requiring disclosure; 5% acquisition triggers initial Reg 31(4) filing obligation.
Open offer requirement when acquirer crosses 25% or proposes to acquire control; exemptions and conditions apply.

framework.ref: Companies Act, 2013 – Section 90 (Substantial Beneficial Owner), Schedule XIII
framework.note: Reporting requirements for beneficial ownership and disclosure of shareholding patterns; coordinated with SEBI disclosures.

framework.ref: SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018 – Schedule III
framework.note: Related party disclosure and capital structure requirements for listed companies undergoing substantial acquisition.

framework.ref: Stock Exchange Listing Agreement / SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
framework.note: Continuous disclosure obligations for material information; updation of shareholding pattern in BSE/NSE filing.

approvals: NSE/BSE exchange filing and acknowledgment of Regulation 31(4) disclosure
